name: v1.1.0
body:
### What's new

- **Settings reorganization**: Settings tab organized into logical sections (GitHub, Output, Tasks, Filter)
- **In-progress checkbox**: New toggle to filter tasks by in-progress state — only items with a checkbox in their title are included
- **Validation guard**: Graceful handling when no GitHub username is configured
- **Test suite**: 20 passing tests with vitest, Obsidian API mock helpers

### Changes
- `settingsTab.ts` — complete layout restructure into collapsible sections
- `settings.ts` — added `inProgressCheckbox` property
- `main.ts` — empty-username guard in sync(), filter respects inProgressCheckbox
- `__tests__/` — vitest suite with smoke tests and Obsidian mock
